title: http.registry.contract.retire.v1.request
description: Retire an active contract registration (active → retired terminal transition). The id is the path parameter; the body carries an optional free-form retirement reason (recorded on the registration's append-only migration event as the transition Reason). The cross-cell contract-retired event and data-plane removal are US8 / US11-US12, not this endpoint.

reason.description: Optional free-form retirement reason recorded as the transition Reason.
